title: Accelerated Access in English to Early Childhood Education

program.section_heading: Accelerated Access in English to Early Childhood Education Certificate of Completion
outcomes: Demonstrate accurate understanding, use, and application of most English grammatical structures to meet most needs and demands in a great variety of early childhood education workplace situations using vocabulary at the low-advanced level.
Respond confidently, fluently, and accurately to a wide variety of social, personal, and professional early childhood education situations at the low-advanced level.

Read, respond, summarize, and interpret low-advanced reading passages and authentic documentation about childcare and child development situations in varying modes and formats using a wide range of academic reading skills and reading strategies.

Write resumes, summaries, reports, evaluations, letters, e-mails, memos, instructions, and multi-paragraph compositions related to early childhood education using academic and vocation-specific vocabulary and accurate use of grammar at the low-advanced level.

notes: Noncredit CDCP Certificate of Completion. The catalog states its total as '0.0 Units' and prints 0 beside each course. It prints no hours, so measure is recorded as units with a total of 0.
The catalog prints the codes without a space ('ELW920', 'ELW921'). They are the closed-list courses ELW 920 and ELW 921, so neither is marked as a catalog addition.

Award Instructions: 'students must complete courses culminating in the successful completion of ELW 921.' This may mean that placement can affect which courses are taken. Both courses are listed under 'Complete all of the following.'
The Award Instructions name the program 'Accelerated Access in English for Early Childhood Education' ('for' instead of 'to').
The lead-in 'Upon satisfactory completion of this award, the student should be prepared to:' appears twice; the outcomes are printed once, under Program Learning Outcomes.
The text names no specific careers or job titles.
